question: Which 10 products sold the most units in 2011, counting both regular and bulk sales?
reference_sql: SELECT product_code, SUM(units + bulk_units) AS units_2011 FROM daily_sales WHERE date >= '2011-01-01' AND date < '2012-01-01' GROUP BY product_code ORDER BY units_2011 DESC LIMIT 10

question: What was total revenue, regular plus bulk, in each month of 2011?
reference_sql: SELECT substr(date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue + bulk_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM daily_sales WHERE date >= '2011-01-01' AND date < '2012-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: In the 2011 backtest at the 95% service level, which 5 products had the most stockout days?
reference_sql: SELECT product_code, stockout_days FROM simulation_summary WHERE service_level = 0.95 ORDER BY stockout_days DESC, product_code LIMIT 5

question: Which products are at or below their reorder point on the last day of the data?
reference_sql: SELECT product_code FROM reorder_status WHERE below_reorder_point = 1

question: Which day of the week has the highest average regular units sold per trading day, across all products?
reference_sql: SELECT t.weekday FROM daily_sales s JOIN trading_days t ON t.date = s.date GROUP BY t.weekday ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(s.units) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.date) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Across all products, how much more holding cost did the 99% service level incur than the 95% level in the 2011 backtest?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN service_level = 0.99 THEN holding_cost ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN service_level = 0.95 THEN holding_cost ELSE 0 END), 2) AS extra_holding_cost FROM simulation_summary

question: For each service level, what fraction of 2011 regular demand was lost to stockouts in the backtest?
reference_sql: SELECT service_level, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(lost_units) / SUM(demand_units), 4) AS lost_share FROM simulation_summary GROUP BY service_level ORDER BY service_level

question: Which products have the longest supplier lead time, and what safety stock does each need at the 95% service level?
reference_sql: SELECT product_code, lead_time_days, safety_stock FROM policy WHERE service_level = 0.95 AND lead_time_days = (SELECT MAX(lead_time_days) FROM policy)

question: Which products sold more than twice as many regular units in the fourth quarter of 2010 as in the first quarter of 2010?
reference_sql: SELECT product_code FROM daily_sales GROUP BY product_code HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2010-10-01' AND '2010-12-31' THEN units ELSE 0 END) > 2 * SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-03-31' THEN units ELSE 0 END)

question: Which service level had the lowest combined holding cost and lost margin across all products in the 2011 backtest?
reference_sql: SELECT service_level FROM simulation_summary GROUP BY service_level ORDER BY SUM(holding_cost + lost_margin) ASC LIMIT 1
